why: Built from BLOODLINE, not from v2, because v2 was killed at 208 games on a pre-committed criterion: combat damage mean 31.38 against bloodline's 35.98 and a win rate of 0.115 against 0.142. The diagnosis is arithmetic I should have caught before spending the run -- v2 traded FIVE CREATURES for FOUR SPELLS, and fewer attackers is less damage. That is the same error mana-recovery made when it bought interaction with three bodies. So every addition here is a CREATURE, and all six come out of yawgmoth-swarm, which the pilot has agreed to break down. Grave Titan is a 6/6 deathtouch that makes four power of 2/2 tokens on entry AND on every attack -- a giant that brings its own fuel, and 2/2s are not the 1/1s the pod blocked all day. Mikaeus gives every non-Human +1/+1 and UNDYING, so the giants come back bigger from the wipes the captain's log keeps losing to. Carrion Feeder does Bloodflow Connoisseur's job for two mana less. Ophiomancer mints a free deathtouch blocker every upkeep. Ayara drains on every BLACK creature entering, and eminence tokens are black Vampires, so every Vampire cast now drains twice. Marauding Blight-Priest turns this deck's heavy lifelink into reach.
